metadata.description: Header detailing the keys and values in this JSON file.
metadata.network_type: Type of network graph, e.g., '1D CW Complex Forest'.
metadata.node_id: Unique integer identifier for each node.
metadata.coord: 3D spatial coordinates as [Z, Y, X]. Z is the slice number, Y and X are pixel coordinates.
metadata.cells_1_linestrings: List of 1-cells (edges/linestrings) connecting the nodes. Empty for a pure centroid collection.
